summary: Jeskola Bass 2's line plays on Neo Poly as a mono legato bass: notes as notes (in its pitch convention), slides as glides, volume as velocity; cutoff, resonance and waveform carry over.

rules.why: assumed: 100 % moves the cutoff 3 octaves (F1 env +50 %)
noise has no oscillator shape on Neo Poly: left as it was

notes.why: Each note lasts to the track's next; velocity 64 with Vel → amp at 100 % and Volume +6 dB plays at the machine's own level.

remarks: No new machine (machine-safety.md §4, H4): Neo Poly in Legato with glide plays the bass line; its ladder filter and envelopes take the cutoff, resonance and envelope settings.

The cutoff and envelope scales are assumed (closed source: the texts are bare 0–100 % or 0–128): a cutoff of 0 % is laid on 80 Hz and 100 % on 16 kHz, logarithmically; the timbres differ, the notes, their lengths, slides and loudness carry over.
Each Jeskola Bass 2 track is its own voice with its own filter; Neo Poly in Legato is one voice: several tracks at once need Voice mode Poly after the move.

tolerance.why_not: Not measured per band: the filters and oscillators are different models and the closed machines' cutoff and envelope scales are unmeasured, so the timbre differs; loudness is matched (the output gain) and checked.

evidence: Machines/Manifests/machine-profile.json: one voice per track, A4 at −9.7 LUFS
